name: Headboard box for the bed alcove, 177
notes: Built to the user's description, not a specific product. A box exactly as wide as the bed alcove of the fitted wardrobe walls (177 cm), standing against the alcove's back panel as a headboard: 177 cm wide, 125 high and 22 deep, with a ledge on top for a phone, books or a small lamp. The item is 24 cm deep: it includes the 2 cm of the alcove's back panel, so wall snap puts the box flush against the panel. Then slide it sideways between the cheeks: it has no play, and with the Distances aid on, the gaps to both cheeks disappear when it's centred. Its front matches the wardrobe: a plinth recessed on the side columns' plinth line, three panels with the doors' joints and mouldings (the module of the top cabinets above) and a top. 125 cm is a boxspring headboard's height (XXXLutz BOXXX 116 cm, IKEA DUNVIK 120 cm) plus about 10 cm; bed-boxspring-160x200 pushed against it leaves 63 cm of it above the mattress. Made for wardrobe-wall-bed-alcove-r5 and wardrobe-wall-bed-alcove-low, whose sconces sit 10 cm above it. It fits the original wardrobe-wall-bed-alcove's alcove too, but there it covers the niches and runs into the sconces. Two looks: in the fronts' colour it reads as part of the wardrobe (the default, lacquer.white), in the lining's walnut as part of the alcove. Colorways (fronts / lining / box): white & walnut, the default (lacquer.white / wood.walnut-natural / lacquer.white); all white (lacquer.white everywhere); all walnut (wood.walnut-natural everywhere); chocolate & walnut (lacquer.chocolate / wood.walnut-natural / lacquer.chocolate); light blue & oak (lacquer.light-blue / wood.oak-natural / lacquer.light-blue); off-white & smoked oak (lacquer.off-white / wood.oak-smoked / wood.oak-smoked). Every finish slot takes lacquer, paint and wood, so any other combination works too, including one colour for everything.
